ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey); white-to-black ratio approximately 0.05:1, with high-intensity pixels limited to distal tip colonies and central base highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-grey pigmentation across 90% of visible surface; distinct light-grey triangular geometric patch at the central peduncle junction; high-contrast tan/white clusters at distal lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; internal angle approximately 65-70 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across both lobes; peak-to-valley amplitude is irregular, increasing in size from the notch toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge curve; lobes exhibit a non-linear upward sweep terminating in acute, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral edges of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-grey linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented horizontally across the lower mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) along the distal trailing edges; irregular jagged notches on the outer margins suggesting minor historical tissue degradation.
other_distinctive_markers: Proninent light-grey triangular pigmentation gradient located at the point of lobe convergence.
